title: KB Corpus
description: Output schema for content-grounding-kb.sh — a privacy-safe teaching corpus assembled from a custom knowledge base (Dify, surreal-memory palace, or local files). Extends the grounding-corpus schema with kb_source and privacy_mode fields.

subject.description: The original human-readable subject string passed to content-grounding-kb.sh.

built_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the corpus was built.

kb_source.description: The --kb flag value that produced this corpus, e.g. 'dify:legal-kb', 'palace:my-palace-id', 'local:/data/docs'.

privacy_mode.description: Must be true. Indicates that no KB content was forwarded to external APIs during corpus assembly.

sources.description: Ordered list of source entries that make up the teaching corpus.

source_ref.description: A stable identifier for the source: URL, file path, KB document ID, palace memory ID, etc.

source_type.description: Category of the source, corresponding to the adapter that produced it.

confidence.description: Retrieval confidence score in the range [0, 1].

is_misconception.description: True when this source documents a known-wrong belief about the subject.

content_summary.description: A brief summary of the source content (at least 10 characters).
